{"test_files": [{"path": "tests/test_service.py", "content": """"Unit tests for the service/repository layer (AC-1..AC-6)."""

import pytest

from app.repository import LinkRepository
from app.service import (
    AliasUnavailableError,
    InvalidTargetUrlError,
    LinkService,
    validate_target_url,
)


@pytest.fixture
def service() -> LinkService:
    return LinkService(repository=LinkRepository())


def test_create_link_generates_a_short_code(service: LinkService) -> None:
    link = service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/very/long/path")
    assert link.code
    assert link.is_custom is False
    assert link.target_url == "https://example.com/very/long/path"


def test_sequential_codes_are_not_adjacent(service: LinkService) -> None:
    a = service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/a")
    b = service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/b")
    assert a.code != b.code
    # the permutation should make consecutive counters land far apart
    assert abs(len(a.code) - len(b.code)) <= 2


def test_get_link_round_trips(service: LinkService) -> None:
    created = service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/x")
    fetched = service.get_link(created.code)
    assert fetched is not None
    assert fetched.code == created.code


def test_get_link_missing_returns_none(service: LinkService) -> None:
    assert service.get_link("doesnotexist") is None


def test_custom_alias_is_honoured(service: LinkService) -> None:
    link = service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/y", custom_alias="myalias")
    assert link.code == "myalias"
    assert link.is_custom is True


def test_reserved_word_alias_is_rejected(service: LinkService) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(AliasUnavailableError):
        service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/z", custom_alias="admin")


def test_duplicate_alias_is_rejected(service: LinkService) -> None:
    service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/1", custom_alias="taken")
    with pytest.raises(AliasUnavailableError):
        service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/2", custom_alias="taken")


def test_non_alphanumeric_alias_is_rejected(service: LinkService) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(AliasUnavailableError):
        service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/1", custom_alias="not-alnum!")


def test_resolve_for_redirect_increments_click_count(service: LinkService) -> None:
    link = service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/click")
    service.resolve_for_redirect(link.code)
    service.resolve_for_redirect(link.code)
    assert service.get_link(link.code).click_count == 2


def test_resolve_for_redirect_missing_returns_none(service: LinkService) -> None:
    assert service.resolve_for_redirect("nope") is None


def test_deactivate_prevents_further_redirects(service: LinkService) -> None:
    link = service.create_link(target_url="https://example.com/deact")
    service.deactivate(link.code)
    assert service.resolve_for_redirect(link.code) is None
    assert service.get_link(link.code).is_active is False


def test_deactivate_missing_returns_none(service: LinkService) -> None:
    assert service.deactivate("nope") is None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# SSRF defence (SEC-003 / AC acceptance criterion)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_rejects_disallowed_scheme() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(InvalidTargetUrlError):
        validate_target_url("ftp://example.com/file")


def test_rejects_loopback_literal() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(InvalidTargetUrlError):
        validate_target_url("http://127.0.0.1/admin")


def test_rejects_private_network_literal() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(InvalidTargetUrlError):
        validate_target_url("http://10.1.2.3/secret")


def test_rejects_link_local_metadata_endpoint() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(InvalidTargetUrlError):
        validate_target_url("http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data")


def test_rejects_hostname_resolving_to_private_ip() -> None:
    def fake_resolver(host, port):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202
        return [(2, 1, 6, "", ("10.0.0.5", 0))]

    with pytest.raises(InvalidTargetUrlError):
        validate_target_url("http://internal.example.com/", resolver=fake_resolver)


def test_allows_public_https_url() -> None:
    def fake_resolver(host, port):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202
        return [(2, 1, 6, "", ("93.184.216.34", 0))]

    validate_target_url("https://example.com/ok", resolver=fake_resolver)  # must not raise


def test_rejects_oversized_url() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(InvalidTargetUrlError):
        validate_target_url("https://example.com/" + "a" * 3000)


def test_unresolvable_host_is_not_blocked_by_dns_failure() -> None:
    def failing_resolver(host, port):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202
        raise OSError("name resolution failed")

    validate_target_url("https://this-host-does-not-exist.invalid/", resolver=failing_resolver)


def test_create_link_rejects_invalid_target_url(service: LinkService) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(InvalidTargetUrlError):
        service.create_link(target_url="http://127.0.0.1/x")

from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_healthz(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.get("/healthz")
    assert resp.status_code == 200

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_readyz(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.get("/readyz")
    assert resp.status_code == 200


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_link_returns_201(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"target_url": "https://example.com/hello"})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["target_url"] == "https://example.com/hello"
    assert body["click_count"] == 0


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_link_rejects_ssrf_target(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"target_url": "http://127.0.0.1/admin"})

    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_target_url"
    assert "request_id" in resp.json()["error"]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_link_with_custom_alias(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/links", json={"target_url": "https://example.com/custom", "custom_alias": "mycode"}
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    assert resp.json()["code"] == "mycode"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_link_reserved_alias_conflicts(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/links", json={"target_url": "https://example.com/x", "custom_alias": "admin"}
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 409
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "alias_unavailable"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_get_link_returns_metadata(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    created = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"target_url": "https://example.com/get-me"})
    code = created.json()["code"]

    resp = await client.get(f"/api/v1/links/{code}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["target_url"] == "https://example.com/get-me"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_get_link_missing_returns_404(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.get("/api/v1/links/doesnotexist")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "not_found"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_redirect_returns_302_to_target(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    created = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"target_url": "https://example.com/redirect-me"})
    code = created.json()["code"]

    resp = await client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
    assert resp.status_code == 302
    assert resp.headers["location"] == "https://example.com/redirect-me"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_redirect_missing_code_returns_404(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.get("/doesnotexist", follow_redirects=False)
    assert resp.status_code == 404


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_redirect_increments_click_count(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    created = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"target_url": "https://example.com/count-me"})
    code = created.json()["code"]

    await client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
    await client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False)

    resp = await client.get(f"/api/v1/links/{code}")
    assert resp.json()["click_count"] == 2


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_delete_link_deactivates_it(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    created = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"target_url": "https://example.com/delete-me"})
    code = created.json()["code"]

    delete_resp = await client.delete(f"/api/v1/links/{code}")
    assert delete_resp.status_code == 204

    redirect_resp = await client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
